lines.text: The LORD sends Jeremiah to the potter's house, where the potter reshapes a flawed vessel into another vessel.
The LORD says Israel is like clay in His hand, and He will relent of disaster if a nation turns from evil.
The LORD tells the men of Judah and the residents of Samaria to turn from their evil ways, but they call it hopeless.
The LORD says His people have forgotten Him and burn incense to idols, so He will scatter them like the west wind.
Some people plan to denounce Jeremiah, and he asks the LORD whether good should be repaid with evil.
